```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE, error = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(SingleCellExperiment)
    library(Matrix)
})
```

Expected: **`r params$n_cells`** cells × **`r params$n_genes`** genes ×
**`r params$n_umis`** UMIs per cell–gene pair
(total UMIs per cell: **`r params$n_genes * params$n_umis`**).

# Load count matrix

```{r load}
sce <- readRDS(params$sce_path)
mat <- assay(sce, 'counts')
cat(sprintf('Count matrix dimensions: %d genes × %d cells\n', nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))
```

# Cell recovery

```{r cells}
n_recovered <- ncol(mat)
expected_cells <- as.integer(params$n_cells)
cat(sprintf('Recovered %d cells (expected %d) — %s\n',
            n_recovered, expected_cells,
            ifelse(n_recovered == expected_cells, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# Gene recovery

```{r genes}
n_genes_detected <- nrow(mat)
expected_genes <- as.integer(params$n_genes)
cat(sprintf('Detected %d genes (expected %d) — %s\n',
            n_genes_detected, expected_genes,
            ifelse(n_genes_detected == expected_genes, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# UMI counts

```{r umis}
expected_umis_per_cell <- as.integer(params$n_genes) * as.integer(params$n_umis)
umis_per_cell  <- colSums(mat)
genes_per_cell <- colSums(mat > 0)

cat(sprintf('UMIs per cell  : min=%d  median=%g  max=%d  (expected %d) — %s\n',
            min(umis_per_cell), median(umis_per_cell), max(umis_per_cell),
            expected_umis_per_cell,
            ifelse(all(umis_per_cell >= expected_umis_per_cell * 0.99), 'PASS', 'FAIL')))

cat(sprintf('Genes per cell : min=%d  median=%g  max=%d  (expected %d)\n',
            min(genes_per_cell), median(genes_per_cell), max(genes_per_cell),
            as.integer(params$n_genes)))

hist(umis_per_cell,
     main  = 'Total UMIs per recovered cell',
     xlab  = 'UMI count',
     col   = 'steelblue', border = 'white')
abline(v = expected_umis_per_cell, col = 'red', lty = 2)
```

# Barcode recovery

```{r barcodes}
expected_barcodes  <- readLines(params$barcodes_path)
recovered_barcodes <- colnames(mat)
n_matched <- sum(recovered_barcodes %in% expected_barcodes)
cat(sprintf('%d / %d recovered barcodes match simulated whitelist — %s\n',
            n_matched, length(recovered_barcodes),
            ifelse(n_matched == length(recovered_barcodes), 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
pass <- (n_recovered       == as.integer(params$n_cells)) &&
        (n_genes_detected  == as.integer(params$n_genes)) &&
        all(umis_per_cell  >= expected_umis_per_cell * 0.99)

cat(sprintf('\nOverall validation: %s\n', if (pass) 'PASS' else 'FAIL'))
```
